connector.name: eToro MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Connect AI assistants to eToro for portfolio analysis, market research, and trading.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package etoro-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the gabrielcerutti account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ETORO_API_KEY
env.description: Your eToro API key (x-api-key header value).

env.name: ETORO_USER_KEY
env.description: Your eToro user key (x-user-key header value) tied to your account.

env.name: ETORO_TRADING_MODE
env.description: Use 'demo' for the practice account or 'real' for live trading.
